correctness.rationale: The shortest border is unbordered, since a border of it would be a shorter border of the original; it cannot overlap its copy, since a nonempty overlap would border it. Conversely an unbordered v in v z v is the shortest border, so each r-layer event counts uniquely by the r lengths and blocks and arbitrary center. Its probability is the r-fold product sum restricted by total peeled length at most n. Monotone passage to the unrestricted sum gives s_q^r. The first two exact terms plus the geometric tail give a strict bound below one (at q=2, at most 7/8; the bound decreases thereafter). Empty-center probabilities are summable over positive even half-lengths, since each complete peel has a unique positive length composition and the sum over layers is s_q/(1-s_q). The limiting width and its mean then follow, the mean by summable domination of the tail probabilities. For the series, the first-part recurrence for constrained compositions gives H_m=F_m/(1+B) with the same triangular recurrence and initial term as a_m; therefore B=S/(1-S) formally. To justify evaluation, for any 0<rho<1 the sum of absolute coefficient norms at radius rho of the a_m is at most product_{j>=1}(1+rho^j)-1, by the triangular recurrence. Thus S is continuous there. The coefficient series B converges for 0<=x<1/2 by the unrestricted composition bound; the identity (1−S)B=S there, together with nonnegative coefficients and S(1/2)=s_2<1, permits passage to the endpoint by monotone convergence. Finally splitting constrained compositions by last part K+1 gives the A274190 recurrence after setting d=N−K; take counts to be zero for negative d, with the empty composition counted for d=0. The reverse row then stabilizes at d once K+1>=d. The b_0 offset accounts for the separate constant 1 in the mean.
residual_risks: The verifier samples unbordered counts (q=2,3, n<=7), short-word tail events (n<=8, r<=3), and formal coefficients through d=16. Neither this check nor the mean table substitutes for the infinite proof. The result concerns uniform fixed-alphabet sampling only.

evidence: Normalizing the finite recurrence gives a convolution by u_m q^(-2m) for each added pair; the base is the unbordered-word count for odd width and the empty word for width zero. Absolute summability permits fixed-width limits by iteration. A274199 gives the composition counts but not the normalization relation F_m/(1+B)=a_m.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The explicit limiting law is a close consequence of those finite counts and unbordered densities. Even taking the geometric law, mean formula and OEIS composition model as given, the generating-series identification B=S/(1−S) using the triangular recurrences is a further argument, producing the conjectured coefficients, not a mere lookup or parameter specialization.

originality.rationale: Credit the known greedy factorization, finite-width recurrence, existence of the limiting mean, the conjectured coefficient sequence, and the already recorded composition model. The distinct contribution supported by the comparison is the proof linking the unbordered-word renewal series to A274199 and hence resolving Conjecture 5. The explicit geometric law and mean formula are useful consequences of the recurrence mechanism, not an independently new mechanism; the distribution is not itself part of Conjecture 5.
residual_risks: The date of the A330886 asymptotic comment was not resolved; the verdict does not depend on it. Bounded primary and catalogue searches cannot exclude an unindexed earlier proof of the coefficient relation.
